scenarios.title: Custodian verifies ownership and releases the item
criteria: Release is impossible before verification; after release both reports are closed and the owner sees the outcome; every step is audited

scenarios.title: Duplicate and different reports
criteria: Re-submitting the same report is refused with a pointer to the original; a different item is accepted

scenarios.title: People cannot do or see what their role does not allow
criteria: Staff functions and other people's data are not available to students; missing or forged identity is refused

steps.name: student cannot open the manual queue
student cannot open another student's report

scenarios.title: A notification that cannot be delivered reaches a human
criteria: A permanent delivery failure creates a manual-queue item; the custodian can re-send and the item resolves

steps.name: failure is routed to the manual queue
re-send delivers and resolves the item

scenarios.title: A temporary delivery problem fixes itself
criteria: A transient failure is retried automatically and no staff action is needed

steps.name: delivered after retries without staff action

scenarios.title: Staff cannot decide a match for their own lost item
criteria: A staff member who lost something cannot verify or release its match; another staff member can

scenarios.title: Wrong claimant rejected; one item, two claimants
criteria: Rejecting a match leaves the reports open; an item can only be released to one person

steps.name: rejected claimant cannot be verified afterwards

criteria: Different categories or generic shared words (a colour, "tag") do not create a candidate; a short lost description still matches a detailed found one

scenarios.title: Unclaimed items: reminder then disposal review
criteria: At 30 days one reminder is raised; at 90 days a disposal review appears; the custodian can dispose; nothing repeats
